title: Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'presentation flips' by evaluating whether the model's preferred verdicts change when the presentation order of options is reversed, using both the self-judged tournament and the MoralChoice benchmark.

Evaluating moral sycophancy and framing acceptance using the ELEPHANT benchmark to measure how often the model simply sides with the user's or narrator's perspective instead of forming an independent moral judgment.
